reason: I already pay for a billing reconciliation and reporting stack that catches unbilled licences and time, so this looks like overlap. I might run the free audit out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay £99 a month for a list of maybes I then have to chase client by client.
objection: Potential leakage isn't money in the bank. Every item means an awkward conversation with a client I want to keep, and £4k over six months on a 15-client demo isn't enough to justify another tool, another round of CSV exports and the time to review it.
would_change_my_mind: If the free audit on my own data turned up a meaningful amount that my current tools had clearly missed, mostly in things I can actually bill without a fight, like unbilled licences and seat growth past the agreement.
